name: qa-time-and-timezones
description: Time-related testing: fake-clock libraries (libfaketime, sinon-fake-timers, jest-fake-timers, freezegun, timecop, mockclock), DST + leap-second references, ISO-8601 vs RFC 3339 reference, and a timezone test matrix builder. Covers time-based bugs (DST transitions, leap seconds, timezone arithmetic, clock skew) which are high-incident-rate but specific tooling is scattered.
